paragraphs: R' Yannai, brother of Rabbi Chiya bar Abba.
Ketubot 21b reads Rabbanai; Ketubot 50b reads Rabbi Benaah. Hyman identifies them all as the same person.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The equation of Yannai, Rabbanai and Benaah is Hyman’s own identification.

Sanhedrin 74b has Rav Yannai, brother of Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba. Berakhot 21b and Ketubot 21b read Rabbanai, without a separate title, while Ketubot 50b reads Rabbi Bannai, beside Hyman's Benaah. The abbreviated R' preserves the abbreviated ר׳ of Hyman's heading without choosing a full title over the witness's Rav. Hyman's equation of the names remains his identification.
